name: GL_SEG_VAL_HIER_RF
description: GL_SEG_VAL_HIER_RF contains the relationship between various nodes in a given tree version in row-flattened manner for the accounting flexfield tree structure. It uses the structure of the FND_TREE_NODE_RF table as a template.
